verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents an Admin/Management API that mirrors the dashboard, plus an MCP server and CLI built on it, but no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. A probe of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths on the docs domain returned 404 for every path. Having an API, CLI, or MCP server is adjacent and does not count as a published spec; confidence is medium because the probe only checked the docs domain.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
